spans.operation: declare an OLS multiple regression predicting total red cards received
exclude cases with any missing values listwise rather than pairwise or with imputation
set p-value thresholds for stepwise variable entry/removal, though the model actually uses forced entry so this criteria may be inert
choose which coefficient, model-fit, collinearity (tolerance/VIF), and R²-change statistics get computed and reported
enter the player/position control variables together as the first predictor block
add average skin-tone rating as a second block to test its incremental effect over the controls
request Durbin-Watson autocorrelation statistic plus residual histogram/normal-probability plots to check regression assumptions
flag and plot cases whose standardized residual exceeds 3 SD as outliers
switch model family to binary logistic regression predicting a dichotomized red-card indicator instead of the continuous count
enter the same covariate set, including mean skin-tone rating, as the first block in both logistic models
add mean implicit-association (IAT) bias score as a second block
add an IAT interaction term as a third block to test moderation
use indicator (dummy) contrast coding instead of the default coding scheme for the categorical position variables amid and cback, consistently across both logistic models
request a Hosmer-Lemeshow goodness-of-fit test and 95% confidence intervals for the odds ratios in both logistic models
add mean explicit-bias score as a second block
add an explicit-bias interaction term as a third block to test moderation

spans.note: title line describing the file as SPSS code for final regression models
section labels (Q1:, Q2a:, Q2b:) marking the start of each analysis block
blank lines separating subcommands throughout the syntax file
NOORIGIN reasserts SPSS's default behavior of including a constant/intercept rather than forcing the regression through the origin
requests descriptive statistics and correlation table output for the Q1 regression
CLASSPLOT requests a classification plot of predicted probabilities for each logistic model
